description: Fetch the full build prompt for one NightMarquee design, tuned for the target tool. When the account may download the demo's footage, the result also lists a short-lived link per clip: save each into public/ under its name before building. Free prompts need no account and their footage needs a free one; Unlimited prompts need Unlimited (run nightmarquee_sign_in).

brand.description: Swap the fictional brand for this name

tool.description: Target tool dialect. Defaults to codex when the client is Codex, otherwise claude

name: nightmarquee_get_prompt

entitled.description: Whether the full build text is included; false means locked or missing

error.description: Set when the prompt could not be fetched

footage.description: The demo's footage, present when the account may download it

name.description: Save the file under this name, in public/

role.description: What the clip shows and how the demo uses it

url.description: Signed download link, valid for footageExpiresInSeconds

footageExpiresInSeconds.description: How long the footage links work

footageMessage.description: Why a demo with footage came without links, such as needing to sign in

pricingUrl.description: Set when the prompt is locked

text.description: The full build prompt, present only when entitled

tool.description: Dialect the text was written for

title: Get a NightMarquee prompt
